name: Three Legs, Three Different Mistakes
_breaks: The three ways a leg fails to name a chain in this asset, one per entry. Leg 1's `root` is `thig`, a typo, and the message has to offer `thigh` — a leg that silently does not resolve is a limb frozen mid-walk while its opposite number strides. Leg 2 names `thigh` as both `root` and `foot`, which is one bone and nothing for a two-bone solver to bend. Leg 3 runs from `thigh` to `arm`, and `arm` hangs off the hip rather than off the thigh — the entry looks entirely reasonable in isolation and is only wrong relative to the hierarchy, which is why the check has to walk `parent` rather than trust the names. `phases` is sized 3 on purpose so the gait rules stay quiet and these three are the only complaints.
